a1_method_manifests.basis: four-family-12-core.v1 plus the explicit live/full review gate and current clean Git commit
a1_method_manifests.reason: This manifest freezes the current method code, registry, pair grid, transport policy, and resume identity before provider execution.

retry_policy.basis: utils.agent transport middleware plus row-local usage/retry identity
retry_policy.provider_retry_exemption: Only a failed provider attempt followed by an actual same-request retry is exempt; the successful attempt remains billable.
retry_policy.reason: The run uses in-place provider recovery without cold cell reruns.

source_provenance.basis: git rev-parse HEAD, git branch --show-current, and tracked git status
source_provenance.reason: The run records the exact clean tracked repository revision used to construct method artifacts.
